_comment: Held-out gate set, n=12, labelled before the Router prompt was ever edited, separate from evals/golden_dataset.json's 18-case set. Decision rules used to label these (fixed before labelling): category=critical only for an immediate safety/health/legal risk needing urgent human attention; category=product for a specific product/price/stock/order/return question; category=general for store info/hours/locations/promotions not tied to one product; urgency=critical only alongside category=critical; urgency=medium for a time-sensitive complaint that is not a safety risk; urgency=low otherwise.
